**Flying enemies.** Choose F4 → Combat → Deaths → **Ragdolls, Hollywood**
and explosions send bodies flying. A monster killed by a rocket, barrel or
BFG blast is thrown back and up, somersaulting, glances off walls and
columns and can reach a second wall before it lands. It no longer goes to
mush: a blast that gibs a monster draws the whole body thrown instead,
while the game's blood and gib sound still play. Shots punch harder too. A
chaingun's last bullet hops the body, a shotgun throws it, a super shotgun
harder, and it spins the way it was struck: a hit off the middle turns it,
a high one tips it over backward. As before, this is drawing only; the
game, its damage and demos are unchanged.

**Simpler combat settings.** The row of death and blood switches in F4 →
Combat is now three choices. **Deaths** goes Classic, Varied, Procedural
falls, Ragdolls or Ragdolls, Hollywood. **Hit reactions** turns flinches
and death jolts on or off. **Blood** is Off, Splats or Full. Your existing
settings carry over.

**Bodies splash into liquids.** A body falling into water, nukage, blood or
lava heaves the surface and throws up a crown of chunky globs and a column
in the middle. A harder fall and a heavier monster throw more, higher and
wider; thick liquids throw fewer, fatter globs and water a spray of foam.
Part of F4 → **Splashes**.

**The F4 panel shows what you changed.** A small diamond marks each option
that differs from its default. Backspace resets just that one; R still
resets everything.

**Quicksave without asking.** A new F4 option, **Confirm quicksave and
quickload** (on by default). Turn it off and F6 and F9 save and load at
once, in DOOM and Heretic.

**Quieter boots in the echoes.** Your own footsteps, splashes and gear keep
their direct sound but put much less into the room's reverb (about 7 dB
less when walking), so quiet movement stays quiet. Steps on metal floors
now sound like a rubber sole on solid steel, a short metallic edge rather
than a hollow ringing deck.

**Launchers with mods.** Launchers hand every enabled mod to every port. A
.pk3 archive, or a lump file whose name is longer than 8 characters, is now
skipped with a note instead of stopping the game.

**Grey concrete stays matte.** DOOM's grey concrete walls, columns and
steps, and the floors and ceilings that go with them, no longer shine like
steel.
